resources.string: Let your computer ring this phone
When you cannot find your phone, make it ring from your computer.

Your phone plays its ringtone at full volume and vibrates for a minute, even when it is set to silent or vibrate, and shows a notification with a button to stop it. Afterwards the volume goes back to what it was. It does not ring during a call. link2linux needs no permission for this.
Shown while a computer makes this phone ring, with a button to stop it
%1$s is looking for it. Tap to stop.
